Two hours, four validators, release and debug: consensus holds (one chain, agreement at three heights, +36,146 to +36,159 blocks per validator, peers 3, zero peer bans, no stall beyond 60s) and, with the state cache out of the measurement, memory holds too — worst growth 398 MiB against the 1 GiB bound (`<repo>/.wt-agent/soak-100b`, `.ai/reports/soak-2h-idle-20260922.md`).
